clauses.heading: Purpose
sentences: The purpose of the policy is to establish the goals and the vision for the breach response process.

This policy will clearly define to whom it applies and under what circumstances, and it will include the definition of a breach, staff roles and responsibilities, standards and metrics (e.g., to enable prioritization of the incidents), as well as reporting, remediation, and feedback mechanisms.

children.heading: Background
sentences: This policy mandates that any individual who suspects that a theft, breach or exposure of <ORGANIZATION NAME> Protected data or <ORGANIZATION NAME> Sensitive data has occurred must immediately provide a description of what occurred via e-­‐mail to Helpdesk@<ORGANIZATION NAME>.org, by calling 555-­‐ 1212, or through the use of the help desk reporting web page at http://<ORGANIZATION NAME>.
If a theft, breach or exposure has occurred, the Information Security Administrator will follow the appropriate procedure in place.

clauses.heading: Scope
sentences: This policy applies to all whom collect, access, maintain, distribute, process, protect, store, use, transmit, dispose of, or otherwise handle personally identifiable information or Protected Health Information (PHI) of <ORGANIZATION NAME> members.
Any agreements with vendors will contain language similar that protects the fund.

children.heading: Confirmed theft, data breach or exposure of <ORGANIZATION NAME> Protected data or <ORGANIZATION NAME> Sensitive data
sentences: 3.0 Policy Confirmed theft, data breach or exposure of <ORGANIZATION NAME> Protected data or <ORGANIZATION NAME> Sensitive data As soon as a theft, data breach or exposure containing <ORGANIZATION NAME> Protected data or <ORGANIZATION NAME> Sensitive data is identified, the process of removing all access to that resource will begin.

The team will include members from: • IT Infrastructure • IT Applications • Finance (if applicable) • Legal • Communications • Member Services (if Member data is affected) • Human Resources • The affected unit or department that uses the involved system or output or whose data may have been breached or exposed • Additional departments based on the data type involved, Additional individuals as deemed necessary by the Executive Director

children.heading: Confirmed theft, breach or exposure of <ORGANIZATION NAME> data
sentences: The Executive Director will be notified of the theft, breach or exposure.
IT, along with the designated forensic team, will analyze the breach or exposure to determine the root cause.

children.heading: Work with Forensic Investigators
sentences: As provided by <ORGANIZATION NAME> cyber insurance, the insurer will need to provide access to forensic investigators and experts that will determine how the breach or exposure occurred; the types of data involved; the number of internal/external individuals and/or organizations impacted; and analyze the breach or exposure to determine the root cause.

children.heading: Develop a communication plan.
sentences: Work with <ORGANIZATION NAME> communications, legal and human resource departments to decide how to communicate the breach to: a) internal employees, b) the public, and c) those directly affected.

children.heading: Roles & Responsibilities:
sentences: • Sponsors -­‐ Sponsors are those members of the <ORGANIZATION NAME> community that have primary responsibility for maintaining any particular information resource.

clauses.heading: Enforcement
sentences: Any < ORGANIZATION NAME > personnel found in violation of this policy may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.
Any third party partner company found in violation may have their network connection terminated.

clauses.heading: Definitions
sentences: Encryption or encrypted data – The most effective way to achieve data security.
